title: How does noise-canceling technology remove sound?

lines.text: How do noise-canceling headphones make roaring airplane jet engines vanish into pure silence?
They don't just physically block sound; they fight sound waves with more sound waves.
Tiny external microphones on the earcups listen to incoming ambient noise hundreds of times per second.
lines.caps: Microphones listen to *outside | noise in *real time

lines.text: An onboard digital processor instantly analyzes the exact sound wave's frequency and amplitude.
The headphone speakers then generate an exact inverted sound wave, shifting the phase by one hundred and eighty degrees.
When the peak of the background noise collides with the valley of the anti-noise wave, destructive interference deletes both.
lines.caps: The waves *collide | and cancel each other out *completely!

lines.text: You are literally hearing silence created by mathematical physics.
